1 Introduction

This chapter presents spatiotemporal data products on commercial fishing activity in the Antarctic Peninsula. Data are sourced from the Global Fishing Watch (GFW) open API (v3), which detects apparent fishing effort by analysing AIS vessel broadcasts and classifying positions as fishing or non-fishing based on changes in speed and heading. Effort is expressed as fishing hours per 0.1° × 0.1° grid cell.

Note

Data caveats: AIS coverage approaches ~90% for vessels >24 m but is substantially lower for smaller vessels. Results represent a lower bound on total fishing activity.

Reproducibility & troubleshooting

Cache files in the working directory:

  • cache_heatmap_data.rds — annual gridded effort (heatmaps + gear plot)
  • cache_trend_data.rds — monthly effort time series (trend section)

The notebook validates the cache on load and automatically deletes and re-fetches if the file is empty or corrupt. To force a full refresh, delete both .rds files before rendering.

If fetches keep failing:

  1. Run print_request = TRUE in a manual gfw_ais_fishing_hours() call to see the exact URL being sent to the API.
  2. Test the request interactively in R and check for HTTP 524 (timeout) or HTTP 429 (rate limit). For 429, wait ~90 seconds and re-render.
  3. Contact GFW support at apis@globalfishingwatch.org with the printed request URL.
